# Version 4.159.0
> **Programmable meshes and image comparisons** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.159.0-rc.2.26576.7)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.159.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159 previews Skia m159 with programmable GPU meshes and an experimental image-comparison package. This line also corrects Windows image-decoding crashes, runtime-effect uniform initialization, and Apple device frameworks. WebAssembly now requires .NET 9 or later, and Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets; unsupported WASM targets are rejected during the build. Retarget WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later and use the matching runtime assets. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged. ([#5700](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5700))
- **Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages for SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. Move 32-bit Linux deployments to a supported architecture, such as x64 or ARM64, before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## Engine

- **Skia m159 and servicing updates** — Updates the native renderer to m159, bringing WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements. Subsequent m159 fixes harden mask-filtered glyph reloads, correct image-filter cache-key equality, and work around Imagination Vulkan descriptor-allocation failures without changing the milestone. ([#5685](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5685), [#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741), [#5769](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5769), [#5841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5841))

## API Surface

- **Programmable GPU meshes** — SKMeshSpecification, indexed and non-indexed mesh builders, vertex/index buffers and SKCanvas.DrawMesh expose custom SkSL vertex and fragment programs. Built meshes retain their native dependencies after the source wrappers are disposed. Drawing requires a GPU-backed surface; raster drawing is a no-op. ([#5760](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5760))
- **Experimental image-comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing adds SKImageComparison for images, bitmaps and pixmaps, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, error metrics and difference images. The separate package is experimental: acknowledge diagnostic SKIA4001 to opt in. Returned comparison results retain no native handles; difference images belong to the caller. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows x64 image error recovery** — Fixes process termination during libjpeg/libpng longjmp error recovery in x64 clang-built natives, including malformed JPEG decoding and PDF output with lazy non-JPEG images. Control Flow Guard remains enabled; x86, ARM64 and MSVC builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@SimonCropp](https://github.com/SimonCropp) ([#5827](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5827))
- **Zero-initialized runtime-effect uniforms** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms blocks now start at zero rather than containing leftover memory. Reset clears the existing buffer in place, avoiding a native buffer and managed wrapper allocation on each call; the fix also covers mesh uniforms. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
- **Filtered texture edges and Tizen blurs** — Ganesh sampling clamps slightly inside texture subsets to avoid undefined exterior texels; CPU and Graphite sampling are unchanged. Tizen now applies its intended CPU blur-path selection when compiling Skia. Texture-edge pixels and Tizen blur output or performance may differ; Tizen performance was not measured. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Correct iOS and tvOS device frameworks** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp device frameworks now contain only arm64 device binaries and device platform metadata, avoiding the simulator slices and metadata that could trigger App Store error ITMS-90087. Separate simulator frameworks and their x64/arm64 slices remain available. — ❤️ [@kdpkke](https://github.com/kdpkke) ([#5649](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5649))
- **Trim-safe MAUI SKGLView binding** — Replaces the string-path Window binding with a typed expression, removing the trimming warning when constructing SKGLView in trimmed MAUI apps without changing the binding's intended behavior. — ❤️ [@bhall-ctre](https://github.com/bhall-ctre) ([#5320](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5320))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp now requires .NET 9 or later for WebAssembly and no longer packages Linux x86 native assets. Its iOS/tvOS device frameworks now contain only arm64 device slices and the correct device metadata, while separate simulator frameworks remain available.

## Release Candidate 2 (November 26, 2026)

Release Candidate 2 adds experimental SkiaSharp.Testing image comparisons, zero-initialized runtime-effect uniforms and trim-safe MAUI SKGLView binding. It also fixes Windows x64 image error-recovery crashes, adjusts Ganesh texture sampling and Tizen CPU blurs, and removes Linux x86 native assets.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.159.0-rc.1.26567.13...v4.159.0-rc.2.26576.7)

## Release Candidate 1 (November 17, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 adds programmable GPU mesh drawing and corrects SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp iOS/tvOS device frameworks. It also incorporates glyph-rendering, image-filter cache and Imagination Vulkan allocation fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22...v4.159.0-rc.1.26567.13)

## Preview 1 (November 14, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m159, including WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements. WebAssembly apps now require .NET 9 or later; non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0...v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22)
